John plays a game for 4 hours a day every day for 2 weeks.  After all that time, he is only 40% done.  He increased his playtime to 7 hours a day.  How long until he finishes the game?

Given:
- John plays 4 hours a day for 2 weeks (14 days).
- After 2 weeks, he is 40% done with the game.
- He then increases his playtime to 7 hours a day.

First, calculate the total playtime in the first 2 weeks:
\[ 4 \, \text{hours/day} \times 14 \, \text{days} = 56 \, \text{hours} \]

Since 56 hours of playtime corresponds to 40% of the game:
\[ 56 \, \text{hours} = 0.4 \times \text{Total game time} \]
\[ \text{Total game time} = \frac{56}{0.4} = 140 \, \text{hours} \]

Now, determine how much time is left to finish the game:
\[ 140 \, \text{hours} - 56 \, \text{hours} = 84 \, \text{hours} \]

With the new playtime of 7 hours a day, calculate the number of days required to finish the remaining 84 hours:
\[ \text{Days required} = \frac{84 \, \text{hours}}{7 \, \text{hours/day}} = 12 \, \text{days} \]

FINAL: 12
